narrative.headline: Find Repark parking with live source vacancy, declared vehicle limits, and verified price estimates.
narrative.value_prop: Search named places or explicit coordinates, inspect source day and night rules, and compare chosen lots. Vacancy and declared vehicle fit remain separate; quotes come from the provider calculator.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public discovery and calculator simulation use no account, token or browser at runtime.

quickstart.comment: Check local setup without a network request.
Resolve a named place through the source.
Inspect source rates and vehicle limits.

troubleshoots.symptom: A location query is ambiguous or yields no anchor.
troubleshoots.fix: Use explicit --lat and --lon with parking nearby, or refine the Japanese place/address.

troubleshoots.symptom: The calculator form is absent or rejects a bay.
troubleshoots.fix: Read the source detail and calculator URL; choose an actual marked bay. No local total is substituted.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Repark time parking discovery by place or explicit coordinates, lot comparison, declared vehicle limits and provider fee estimates. Include exact JST entry/exit times and bay for a quote.
anti_triggers: Other parking providers or personal live location
